# ship-design

Patch rows on this catalog use `"catalog": "ship-design"` and a `key` from the records below. The catalog is closed: a mod changes values with patch rows (see [Patch operations](patch-ops.md)) and cannot add records.

## Records

`classic`

## Copy this row

A row that changes nothing: `value` and `expect` both hold the base value. Change `value` to the number you want.

```json
{
  "op": "set",
  "catalog": "ship-design",
  "key": "classic",
  "path": "arcs.all.pct",
  "value": 50,
  "expect": {"arcs.all.pct":50}
}
```
